title: Vivaldi browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each Vivaldi profile holds history, sessions, mail accounts and saved logins. The profiles show who used the browser and what they were doing.
source: BrowserForensics, Brave/Opera/Vivaldi profile locations: Vivaldi on Linux keeps profiles under ~/.config/vivaldi/<profile>: https://www.browserforensics.app/en/blog/brave-opera-vivaldi-profile-locations
notes: Vivaldi is Chromium-based; the directory is lowercase vivaldi and profiles are Default, Profile 1, ... Matches the Preferences marker file. Vivaldi Snapshot uses a separate vivaldi-snapshot tree and is not matched.
